text:
deploy-bot: Deploy started -> environment: dedicated/eu2, tag: v2.14.1-rc3, commit: abc1234def. initiator: alex kim. change window: 2026-03-20 22:00-23:30 UTC. rolling update (3 nodes). running preflight checks.

alex kim: kicking this off, dashboard: https://dash.redwood.internal/deploys/1799901234

ops-bot: Reminder: change window active. no manual infra changes without approval :lock:

deploy-bot: preflight: artifact checksum mismatch on node-2 (expected d41d8cd98, got d41d7cd98). pausing rollout.

cheng li: saw that — re-pushing artifact to node-2 now. ping when done.

deploy-bot: push to node-2 completed. re-running preflight checks.

deploy-bot: preflight OK. proceeding to flip traffic on node-2.

maria rodriguez: quick note: rollback criteria = latency > 200ms sustained for 5m OR error rate > 0.5%. tagging @cheng for observability.

deploy-bot: canary step: node-2 active on v2.14.1-rc3. smoke tests: 22/22 passed. p95 changed +8ms. trace id: trace::0x9ab

olivia: infra looks green. starting controlled load: ramp to 20 qps over 3m.

deploy-bot: load ramp schedule: 1m@5qps -> 2m@10qps -> 3m@20qps. current p95: 86ms.

alex kim: noticed a transient spike to 420ms at 12:04 UTC, correlated with node-1. @cheng can you check GC / agent health?

cheng li: investigating. logs show a long GC on node-1 around 12:04 and older agent version running. to be safe, proposing to pin node-1 back to v2.14.0 while we diagnose. need approval to pin routing.

maria rodriguez: approve the pin. prefer stable canary rather than risking broad rollback. :thumbsup:

deploy-bot: pin applied -> node-1 pinned to v2.14.0. routing adjusted: no new traffic to node-1. canary remains node-2 on v2.14.1-rc3.

deploy-bot: continuing rollout to node-3. smoke tests pending.

deploy-bot: node-3 smoke tests: 20/20 passed. starting final cutover.

deploy-bot: rollout complete. summary: deployed v2.14.1-rc3 to dedicated/eu2 (nodes 2 & 3), node-1 pinned to v2.14.0 due to agent/GC anomaly. release tag: v2.14.1-rc3. commit: abc1234def. deployed by: alex kim. duration: 7m 44s.

alex kim: thanks everyone. i'll open a follow-up to remediate node-1 agent and schedule a second pass in next maintenance window. :party_parrot:

oncall-bot: Recorded release note -> v2.14.1-rc3 (partial pin on node-1). follow-up ticket required: INFRA-3421. assigned to cheng li.

cheng li: filing INFRA-3421 now with logs and GC heap dumps attached.

ops-bot: noted in change log and incident tracker. leaving monitoring hooks for 24h.

deploy-bot: closing thread: all active checks green. if regressions appear, use /revert v2.14.1-rc3 or reach out to oncall.
